title: BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEvent
description: A workflow run's plan left a phase, or the run's end closed it. Emitted once for every `workflow_run.phase_started` event, before the run's `workflow_run.status_ended` event. The event does not say whether the plan finished the phase's work, or why it left.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

workflow_run_phase_id.description: Identifier of the phase, as in `phases` on the run's `workflow_run.created` event.

phase_started_id.description: Identifier of the `workflow_run.phase_started` event that opened the phase.
